name: Functional Benchmark
description: A curated benchmark of functional/programming tasks intended to evaluate correctness and generalization of program synthesis systems.
reputation: Well-regarded in the program synthesis community as a curated benchmark to evaluate correctness and generalization of synthesis systems.
notes: Evaluation is based on executing generated programs against test suites (functional correctness). Tasks can be handcrafted and may have limited scope; potential dataset-model contamination is unknown; not primarily an LLM-only benchmark.
